paragraphs.text: Six contractors submitted prices for equipment work at Pontotoc’s wastewater treatment plant. Century Construction Group of Tupelo listed the lowest base bid at $589,341, followed by Hemphill Construction of Florence at $593,744. The difference is $4,403, according to the certified bid sheet for the Nov. 3 opening.

The base project covers two replacement sewer pumps, rebuilding a mechanical screen and replacing the grit drive, grit pump and V-force baffles. The city requested a separate price for replacing two sludge pumps.

Including the sludge pumps would reverse the order of those two bids. Century priced the alternate at $134,284, bringing its combined price to $723,625. Hemphill listed $63,412 for the alternate, or $657,156 with the base work. The totals depend on which work the city selects.

Engineering Solutions certified the prices received for the city. The original bid notice allows up to 60 days after the opening for review of proposals and contractor qualifications. The tabulation identifies bidders and prices without naming a contractor for the work.
